name: Lusankya
description: The Lusankya was an Executor-class Star Dreadnought ordered for the navy of the Galactic Empire. After the loss of the Imperial Death Star at the Battle of Yavin, the tactical importance of the Empire's Super Star Destroyer project increased. The Star Dreadnought Lusankya was undergoing assembly at Kuat Drive Yards' Kuat shipyards at the time of its sister ship Executor phase of construction at the Fondor Shipyards.
